before_results.readmission: The positive class is patients readmitted to the hospital within 30 days. Missing a positive matters more because failing to identify a patient at risk could prevent them from receiving additional support or follow-up care after discharge.
before_results.diabetes: The positive class is patients with a diabetes diagnosis or HbA1c ≥ 6.5%. Missing a positive matters more because it could delay further testing, diagnosis, and treatment for patients who may have diabetes.
